summary: School district urges FCC to preserve E-Rate program to maintain essential broadband infrastructure for modern public education. The technology director urges preservation of the E-Rate program, emphasizing its role in providing reliable broadband infrastructure for schools and libraries. The technology director argues against sunsetting the program and supports preserving its funding and eligibility criteria.

claims.argument: Cutting E-Rate would increase local costs for maintaining network infrastructure
claims.evidence_quote: In the School District of Reedsburg, E-Rate covers roughly 70% of our fiber and Wi-Fi costs-totaling about $115,000 per year. Absorbing that expense locally would force us to defer critical network security upgrades and trim essential instructional staff.

filer_raw: Denise Peterson | School District of Reedsburg
